Your role is evolving from a reactive fixer to a proactive performance consultant. While the physical act of turning a wrench or replacing a bowstring remains a human craft, the 'detective work' of your job is being revolutionized. Instead of manually searching through thick repair manuals or guessing at a mechanical failure, you will use Augmented Reality (AR) and AI diagnostics to see exactly where a component is failing and receive step-by-step visual guidance for the repair. AI handles the tedious record-keeping and follow-up logistics, freeing you to focus on the physical craftsmanship and customer interaction.

You will increasingly act as a technical advisor, using AI-driven trend analysis and predictive maintenance data to tell athletes not just what is broken, but how to optimize their gear for better performance. By automating routine customer service and maintenance logging, you can spend more time on complex troubleshooting and providing high-touch, personalized service that builds long-term loyalty. Your expertise is no longer just in your hands, but in your ability to integrate digital diagnostics with physical skill.

n.story:
In the industrial sector, your role is rapidly shrinking as AI-driven automation takes over the end-to-end production line. Tasks that once required human oversight—like temperature control, wick insertion, and quality grading—are now handled with superior precision by sensors and computer vision. For those in mass production, the role is shifting toward high-level process management and the maintenance of the AI systems that run the factory floor.

However, for the artisanal candle maker, AI offers a different path: amplification of the 'formula' rather than the 'form.' You can use AI to experiment with complex wax blends and scent profiles, predicting how different materials will burn or interact before you ever melt a single block of wax. While the machine handles the repetitive pouring and cooling, you are freed to focus on the high-concept design of moulds and the artistic finishing that makes a product 'luxury.' The future of this role is a stark divide between the automated factory and the AI-augmented studio.
